title: Helium Demand Is Headed Toward 190
hook: Helium demand is projected to nearly double by 2035.
closing: Rising demand makes a concentrated supply more vulnerable and expensive.
question: Where should helium be prioritized?

segments.say: Qatar holds 10.1 billion cubic meters of helium. A few suppliers shape global access.
Helium demand is projected to reach an index of 190. Buyers will chase a limited supply.
The helium price index reached 400. Supply tightness can quickly hit buyers.
